question: can the IPC classification in the patent XML stand in for image labels
coverage: 158 of 158 curated patents carry an IPC code
verdict: A PRIOR, NOT AN AUTHORITY. It raises the drawing rate of the pool from ~71% (corpus filter) to ~82% and cuts it to 4654 patents, but 82% is far from the 98% an automated authority needs, and the rule discards 31 good drawings in G/H (electrical) for every 45 it keeps. It narrows where to label; it does not replace labelling.
owner_decision: mechanical-only subset by IPC section, plus ~1000 hand labels inside it
